Resolves #21663

The Input masks caption keeps its five masks in 91 characters instead of 104: "The PrefixField plugin masks a phone number, a date, a MAC address, a code and a card number". It now reads whole on the Forms page down to the 301 px card, and `seo.json` carries the generator's description for the record.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chrome measurement on the Forms page, released and changed) → L3 required (AC-1 is a browser observation). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: data-leaf — one caption string and its generated SEO line, no code.

|---|---|

| AC-2 `seo.json` carries the generator's output | Outside CI: `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs#formatStandaloneExampleSeo` on the new record reproduces the stored title and writes the new description |
